retention_tricks: Rapid cuts/pacing: Quick transitions, never a static shot for more than 1 second.
On-screen text/captions: Reinforce key points, cater to sound-off viewing, add visual interest.
Binge-worthy series: Create themed shorts that encourage watching the next one in a sequence.
Sound design/music: Energetic, trending background music, sound effects for emphasis and humor.
Question/challenge at midpoint: Engage viewer actively during the short to maintain attention.
Loopable endings: Seamless transition back to the beginning, encouraging re-watches and higher retention.
